zh.title: 视觉小说模式
zh.text:
点顶栏的「视觉小说」，最新一条回复就变成游戏画面：场景做背景，说话的人站在前面，名字栏、打字机，一句一句往下读。
开关按角色卡记住；发给模型的内容一字不改，缓存不受影响。

en.title: Visual novel mode
en.text:
Switch on Visual novel in the top bar and the latest reply plays like a game: the scene behind, whoever speaks in front, a name plate and typewriter text, one line at a time.
Remembered per card; what the model is sent never changes, so the cache is untouched.

zh.title: 每个人都有立绘
zh.text:
谁说话谁站出来，旁白时退下。配图名单里白底的人设图自动抠图、描白边；没有能用的就按长相画一张半身立绘。
说话人自动认出来——连「她说」「掌柜的愣了一下」这种也认得；名字栏按人分颜色，对白和旁白分开上色。

en.title: A sprite for everyone
en.text:
Whoever speaks steps forward; during narration they step back. White-background reference pictures in the cast list are cut out and outlined; anyone without one gets a half-body sprite drawn from their looks.
Speakers are told even from "she said" or a nameless innkeeper; each name plate has its own colour, and dialogue is coloured apart from narration.

zh.title: 场景图
zh.text:
故事到了新地点，自动画一张没有人物的场景当背景，存在这张卡下面，下次到同一个地方直接用。也可以「画这一轮的场景」，按这一轮写的样子画。
傍晚、夜里、雨、雪用色调和动画表现，不用重画。

en.title: Scenes
en.text:
When the story reaches a new place, an empty scene is drawn for it as the background, kept with the card and reused whenever the story returns. Or draw this turn's scene, as the reply describes it.
Dusk, night, rain and snow are tints and animations over it, not new pictures.

zh.title: 像游戏一样选
zh.text:
读到最后，行动选项在画面中央弹出来，按 1–4 直接选，✎ 先改再发，也可以自己写。
还有回看、自动、跳过、全屏（F）、逐句朗读，一条回复中途换地点时背景也跟着换。

en.title: Choose like in a game
en.text:
At the end of a reply the choices open in the middle of the picture: press 1–4 to pick, ✎ to edit one first, or write your own.
Also: backlog, auto, skip, full screen (F), line-by-line reading, and the background follows the story when it moves on halfway through a reply.

zh.title: 导入 SillyTavern 的对话
zh.text:
把 SillyTavern 的对话记录（.jsonl）拖进窗口，或者在角色卡下点「导入存档」：每一轮、每个 swipe、MVU 变量都带过来。
很长的对话可以先压缩成剧情存档，之后只发存档和最近两轮，原文都还在。

en.title: Import SillyTavern chats
en.text:
Drop a SillyTavern chat (.jsonl) into the window, or use Import archive under a card: every turn, every swipe and the MVU variables come with it.
A long one can be compacted into a story archive first, so each turn sends only the archive and the last two turns; the full text stays.

zh.title: 手机添加到主屏幕
zh.text:
开着「手机访问」时，iPhone 用 Safari、安卓用 Chrome 打开链接，添加到主屏幕后像 App 一样全屏打开，不用再输口令。
朗读的控制条也变成了输入框上方的小胶囊，不再挡住输入框。

en.title: On your phone's home screen
en.text:
With phone access on, open the link in Safari (iPhone) or Chrome (Android) and add it to the home screen: it opens full screen like an app, no key to type again.
The read-aloud controls are now a small pill above the input instead of a bar over it.

zh.title: 每个角色有自己的音色
zh.text:
在「配图与朗读 → 朗读 → 音色」里，给角色名册里的每个人选一个音色，没选的用对白音色。
视觉小说模式按每句的说话人读；普通模式点「朗读」或点一句对白也一样，两个人挨着说的话不再连成一段。

en.title: A voice for each character
en.text:
In Pictures & voice → Voice → Voices, give everyone in the cast a voice of their own; anyone without one takes the dialogue voice.
Visual novel mode reads each line in its speaker's voice, and so do Read aloud and clicking a line; two people's lines next to each other are no longer read as one.

zh.title: 视觉小说里直接改设置
zh.text:
右上角「朗读」「配图」旁边的 ▾：逐句朗读、自动翻页、各人的音色、朗读模型；新回复自动配图、场景和立绘怎么画、画图方式和模型、画幅。
改了马上保存，「更多…」打开完整的设置。

en.title: Settings right in the visual novel
en.text:
The ▾ beside Read and Pictures at the top right: line-by-line reading, auto-advance, everyone's voice and the voice model; pictures for new replies, how scenes and sprites are drawn, the image backend, model and shape.
Changes save at once; More… opens the full settings.

zh.title: CG 回廊
zh.text:
右上角「CG」或按 G：这条故事线上所有的配图，标着是开场还是第几轮。
点一张全屏看，← → 翻遍所有 CG，Esc 回到回廊。

en.title: CG gallery
en.text:
CG at the top right, or G: every picture on this storyline, each marked with its turn.
Open one full size, ← → go through all of them, Esc goes back to the gallery.

zh.title: 更多画图方式和音色
zh.text:
新增 Gemini 原生生图（Nano Banana，能照人设图画）、本地的 SD WebUI / Forge，OpenRouter 的出图模型也能用了；朗读多了 Gemini 的 30 个音色。Gemini 用「Gemini」模板建的供应商，和对话共用密钥。
还没设好的画图方式和朗读来源，会在「配图与朗读」里标出来。

en.title: More ways to draw and to speak
en.text:
New: Gemini's own image models (Nano Banana, following reference pictures), local SD WebUI / Forge, and OpenRouter's image models; Gemini's 30 voices for reading aloud. Gemini uses the provider made from the Gemini template, the same key as chat.
An image backend or voice source that isn't set up yet now stands out in Pictures & voice.

zh.title: 名字栏更准
zh.text:
冒号前的叙述（「嘴角翘起来：」「笑得很短：」）不再被当成人名，「柏木绾追问」「顾言如实说」这类认得出名字；刚打开一张卡时，第一句的名字栏也不会错。
另外修了：视觉小说里选完选项后，输入框只剩一条缝。

en.title: Sharper name plates
en.text:
Narration before a colon is no longer taken for a name, and more ways of naming who speaks are understood; the first line's plate is right when a card has just opened.
Also fixed: the input box shrinking to a sliver after a choice in visual novel mode.
